relations.rationale: Sitting together during lunch supports the idea they could have compared notes together at that time.
Kai sitting with Vik is unrelated to Isla's separate activity of checking on progress.
Kai and Vik's conversation is unrelated to Sami helping another participant.
Kai and Vik comparing notes is unrelated to Sami's reaction to a wheel axle popping off.

Sami laughing about the axle is unrelated to the group discussing the next session.
Isla not being the lead volunteer has no bearing on Vik's reactions to his robot's performance.

Vik's enjoyment during the competition is unrelated to the group sweeping the floor afterward.
